maps.name: Marked square source
maps.domain: p hard prime; q
maps.codomain: Original integer source (p,q,sigma,t,R0,R,A)
maps.inverse_or_fibre: Retain q,t,sigma; A returns R=4A-p. R alone need not identify the original square marking.
maps.information_loss: No q or square marking is dropped. A varies with t.

maps.name: Centered exponent box
maps.domain: A=product l^e; beta_l in [-e,e]
maps.codomain: Divisors u of A^2, including all distinct words
maps.inverse_or_fibre: beta_l=v_l(u)-e_l; bijective
maps.information_loss: Reducing u modulo R is a separate many-to-one observation.

maps.name: Fine residue count
maps.domain: Free integer module on original beta vectors
maps.codomain: Integer coefficients on (Z/R)^x
maps.map: v(beta)=u A^(-1) mod R; sum coefficients along equal v
maps.inverse_or_fibre: Fibre consists of the original exponent vectors with that residue; least representative plus all difference coordinates reconstructs it.
maps.information_loss: Support loses multiplicity; parity can send a present coefficient to supported zero.

maps.name: Divisor normalization
maps.domain: A>p/4; u|A^2; full source retained
maps.codomain: h,r,s positive; gcd(r,s)=1; A=hrs; u=hr^2
maps.inverse_or_fibre: A=hrs; u=hr^2; d=hr
maps.information_loss: None with source and channel retained.

maps.name: Exterior return
maps.domain: Original E state: R|4u+1
maps.codomain: Ordered positive ES denominators
maps.inverse_or_fibre: u=A^2/(Ry-pA), then gcd normalization; source p,R retained
maps.information_loss: A permutation would lose the chosen denominator order unless recorded.

maps.name: Middle return
maps.domain: Original M state: R|4u+p
maps.codomain: Ordered positive ES denominators
maps.inverse_or_fibre: u=p A^2/(Ry-pA), then gcd normalization
maps.information_loss: Reversal y,z changes u to A^2/u and remains marked.

maps.name: Auxiliary exterior to first half
maps.domain: E hit with A>p/2 in source range A<p
maps.codomain: First-half E hit with first two denominators exchanged
maps.inverse_or_fibre: Same transposition, retaining old R and ordered outputs
maps.information_loss: No assertion that an upper-half M hit exists; it is impossible.

maps.name: Elsholtz--Tao coordinates
maps.domain: Normalized E or M state
maps.codomain: Their six coordinates and their denominator order
maps.inverse_or_fibre: Read coordinates and recorded permutations [1,2,0] or [0,2,1]
maps.information_loss: Additional parameters do not change the original channel.

maps.name: Exact base carry
maps.domain: Original base candidate u|A_t^2 with R0|(4u+eta_c)
maps.codomain: Digit d in [0,t^2), integer quotient b, original source/channel
maps.inverse_or_fibre: u=(R0(d+t^2 b)-eta_c)/4 exactly when positive integral divisor of A_t^2
maps.information_loss: Keeping d only forgets the full allowed b fibre. No coprimality of R0,t is assumed.

maps.name: Channel coefficient pushforward
maps.domain: Integer module on original base candidates
maps.codomain: Integer polynomial in degree 0,...,t^2-1
maps.inverse_or_fibre: Kernel generated by e_u-e_u* for every occupied digit fibre; retain nonselected coordinates and fibre sum.
maps.information_loss: Augmentation P(1) counts projected candidates, not full hits.

maps.name: Common-divisor source span
maps.domain: Two marked sources at t and t-prime for the same p,q
maps.codomain: Their exact common original divisor domain
maps.inverse_or_fibre: Inverse subtracts the valuation difference; k_c(u) is unchanged
maps.information_loss: The full tests t^2|k and t-prime^2|k are distinct. No whole-box map is asserted.

maps.name: Quadratic root observation
maps.domain: r in V_p excluding q; original quadratic F_q(j)
maps.codomain: Zero or two roots modulo r
maps.map: F_q(j)=A_1+sigma q j(j+1); discriminant=-sigma q p
maps.inverse_or_fibre: The roots are exchanged by j->-1-j; no fixed root. r=q has no roots.
maps.information_loss: A root is factor eligibility, not an original selector hit.

maps.name: CRT intersection of factor roots
maps.domain: A finite subset J of eligible distinct primes
maps.codomain: Complete 2^|J| root set modulo product(J)
maps.map: Usual CRT on each original root choice
maps.inverse_or_fibre: Reduction to each prime recovers its choice
maps.information_loss: Each resulting root is still evaluated on the same source index j.

maps.name: C-free source index count
maps.domain: Original prefix 0<=j<N and finite C containing q
maps.codomain: Exact integer count Z_C(q,N)
maps.map: Inclusion-exclusion over CRT roots with literal floor counts
maps.inverse_or_fibre: Full witness indices are retained separately; a count is not a factorization.
maps.information_loss: C-free is sufficient, not necessary, for a nonresidue factor outside C.

maps.name: Prime-power root lift
maps.domain: r-root x modulo r^a with derivative a unit
maps.codomain: Unique corresponding root modulo r^(a+1)
maps.inverse_or_fibre: Reduction modulo r^a
maps.information_loss: Both root branches retained; valuation sums count all powers up to the exact source bound.

maps.name: All-edge square factor relation
maps.domain: Marked source A_t with complete factorization
maps.codomain: Every nonresidue prime factor r and its original weight
maps.inverse_or_fibre: Retain source and complete factorization; an endpoint pair alone does not recover it.
maps.information_loss: No even multiplicity or alternate outgoing edge is discarded.

maps.name: Mixed reciprocity eligibility
maps.domain: Ordered distinct nonresidue primes and their mod-12 types
maps.codomain: Actual two-direction eligibility bits
maps.inverse_or_fibre: Retain q,r,Legendre values,types
maps.information_loss: Eligibility does not assert that a finite bounded port realizes the edge.

maps.name: Cycle affine composition
maps.domain: Ordered simple canonical prime cycle with sigma_i,c_i
maps.codomain: D-S and all cyclic numerators T_i
maps.map: D=4^ell product c; S=product sigma; D_j+1=4cD_j; T_j+1=sigma T_j+D_j
maps.inverse_or_fibre: h=gcd T_i; p=(D-S)/h; q_i=T_i/h; require all original prime/type/range/edge tests
maps.information_loss: Rotating the cycle changes marking; repeated least cofactors create duplicate rooted profiles, not extra cycles.

maps.name: Finite cofactor range
maps.domain: Hypothetical closed C of size m
maps.codomain: Finite union of coefficient boxes, each with explicit integers
maps.inverse_or_fibre: Cycle inverse plus all original filters; these conditions are necessary, not sufficient for closure.
maps.information_loss: The finite reduction does not assume that every coefficient candidate is a valid graph.

maps.name: Monotone pruning certificate
maps.domain: Partial positive cofactor word, future coordinates at minimum v
maps.codomain: Exact retained intervals and excluded subboxes
maps.map: Range ratios T_i/(D-S) strictly decrease in each coordinate; main affine upper bound (25)
maps.inverse_or_fibre: Every retained full word is enumerated; excluded box has an exact violated inequality at its maximal-ratio corner.
maps.information_loss: The digest records enumeration order but is not the mathematical proof of completeness.

maps.name: Bounded reachable expansion
maps.domain: Any original vertex at a hard prime
maps.codomain: At least six distinct reachable vertices and labelled factor paths
maps.map: Breadth-first exploration of valid t=1,3,5,7,9; stop when six discovered
maps.inverse_or_fibre: Every path stores q,t,R,A,factorization and factor weight
maps.information_loss: Expansion is not a proof that any source is occupied.
